items.title: Opioid settlement claims from self-funded plans due Dec. 1 - www.hcamag.com
items.reason: This item addresses payer enforcement and settlement obligations stemming from opioid litigation, requiring self-funded plans to submit claims by a specific deadline, which directly impacts payer compliance and revenue-cycle processing.
items.summary: Self-funded health plans must submit claims to the opioid settlement by December 1st deadline. This enforcement action requires plan administrators to file for reimbursement from the multi-billion dollar opioid litigation settlements, directly affecting how self-funded employers and their health plans process and recover settlement proceeds. Revenue-cycle teams managing self-funded plans need to ensure timely claim submission to capture available settlement funds, as missed deadlines could result in forfeiture of compensation owed to the plans.
